Test fixture sources
====================

aescrypt/
  84 AES Crypt known-answer vectors (stream versions 0-3, 21 each), password "Hello".
  From aescrypt-rs (https://github.com/Slurp9187/aescrypt-rs), tests/test_data,
  MIT licensed - see LICENSE-MIT-aescrypt-rs. Byte-identical to the vectors in the
  official AES Crypt engine's test suite.

pyaescrypt/
  AES Crypt v2 files, including a 2.5 MB file and a non-ASCII password.
  Generated with pyAesCrypt (https://github.com/marcobellaccini/pyAesCrypt),
  an independent implementation.

scr2/
  ShadowCrypt v2 files generated by ShadowCrypt 1.2.1's original Node.js encryptor.

Each *_fixtures.json lists the password and the SHA-256 of the expected plaintext.
